subject: general
question: Who launched the National Single Window System for investors and businesses in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Piyush Goyal**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__

• The **National Single Window System (NSWS)** was officially launched by the Union Minister of Commerce and Industry, **Piyush Goyal**, in **September 2021**.

• It is a **digital platform** that serves as a **one-stop shop** for investors, entrepreneurs, and businesses to identify and apply for the **approvals and clearances** required to start or expand operations in India.

• The primary objective of the NSWS is to enhance the **Ease of Doing Business** by eliminating the need for investors to visit multiple departments or use various portals for different licenses.

• The system provides **end-to-end facilitation**, including pre-investment advisory, information on land banks, and tracking the status of applications in real-time.

• It integrates various **Central Ministries** and **State Departments** into a single unified interface, reducing **bureaucratic hurdles** and duplication of effort.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• The creation of a **Investment Clearance Cell (ICC)**, which later became the NSWS, was first announced by the Finance Minister in the **Union Budget 2020-21**.

• The platform is managed and developed by the **Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)** under the **Ministry of Commerce and Industry**.

• **Piyush Goyal** currently serves as the **Union Minister of Commerce and Industry**, and has previously held portfolios like Railways, Textiles, and Consumer Affairs.

• The portal features a **Know Your Approval (KYA)** service, which generates a list of required approvals based on the specific details of the business project provided by the user.
